note: The first run of a fresh save (phase 16, scripts/core/tutorial.gd). Read by the splash, the run (scripts/run/tutorial_flow.gd), Home (scripts/ui/home_guide.gd) and the sims.
result_line: Tutorial done! The town is yours.

steps.text: You attack on your own. Bonk 10 critters!
Walk over gems to pick them up.
Gems fill the XP bar. Fill it to level up!
steps.card_text: Pick a card. Each one makes you stronger.

steps.text: A chest! Walk into it to open it.
Stand in the beacon to charge it.
Follow the red arrow and stand on the altar.
Beat Mega Mole! Step out of red circles.
You won! Walk into the portal.

targets.text: Tap Claim to get your coins.
You finished a quest! Tap Quests.

home_steps.text: Go back Home and tap Quests.

targets.text: Buy Fireworks. It joins your level-up cards.
